title: Emissions intensity · {year}
intro: Committed emissions per configured denominator. Only metrics with a configured value for {year} are shown.
pickRequired: Pick a subsidiary and enter a value above zero.
emptyNoFigures: No Scope 1 or 2 figures for {year} in this selection
